justification: Assessment reported INVALID and targeted exactly the ground-truth defect: the claim that the expansion hypothesis forces delta(G) > alpha*n (Lemma 1, contradiction asserted at line 0052). Its witness is the same construction as the ground truth's (complete graph plus one isolated vertex): K_9 + isolated vertex at n=10, alpha=0.1 vs ground truth's K_5 + isolated vertex at n=6, alpha=1/3. Checked concretely: any 5-set S in the K_9 instance contains >=4 clique vertices, so N(S)={1..9}, |N(S)|=9 >= n/2+alpha*n=6, hypothesis satisfied, yet delta(G)=0 which is not > alpha*n=1. Different-but-valid witness for the same false claim, so matching.
